title.native: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン

description:
A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

node.description: A young lady of the Liston family. Although she died of illness at a tender age, she was resurrected via a forbidden ritual; outwardly, she appears to be a charming young noblewoman. However, the soul inhabiting her body is that of a warrior once hailed as a "God-Slaying Hero"—a spirit that still craves life-or-death battles against formidable foes. Aiming to popularize her family's business—"magic imagery"—she appears on broadcasts and becomes an idol?

name.native: レリアレッド・シルヴァー

node.description:
The youngest daughter of the Silver family. She is a popular TV personality at the Silver Domain Broadcasting Station, beloved for her age-appropriate, straightforward, and lively personality.

She views [Nia](https://anilist.co/character/325674/Liston-Nia)—who is the same age and in a similar position—as a rival, though she is sometimes exasperated by Nia’s wild antics. She ends up working alongside Nia and [Hilde](https://anilist.co/character/405063/Altoir-Hildetora) to promote magical videos.

name.native: ヒルデトーラ・アルトワール

node.description:
The third princess of the Kingdom of Altoir. Although a member of the royal family, she is a star talent with the Royal Capital Broadcasting Station, and her catchphrase is “A Princess You Can Actually Meet.”

She invites the new students, [Nia](https://anilist.co/character/325674/Liston-Nia) and [Relia](https://anilist.co/character/405064/Silver-Reliared), and the three of them work together to promote magical videos. Despite her young age, she also has an ambitious side, aiming to conquer the world through magical videos.

A hired bodyguard in the criminal underworld. Confident in his combat skills and adept at using magic weapons, he challenges Nia to a fight under his boss's orders. He is a heavy smoker with a cold, rational mindset.

A promising young actress with the theater troupe "Ice Rose." Although she lands her long-awaited first starring role, her intense passion for the stage causes her to overreach and stumble. She also struggles to be open and honest, at times harshly critiquing Nia, her co-star.

The production manager for the Liston Territory Channel and the host of the program *Tales of the Liston Territory*. Viewers often remark that he spends his time on location doing nothing but drinking, and he is known for his persistent, cloying smile. He also has a tendency to foist grueling filming schedules onto Nia.

An underworld bodyguard and an assassin who employs concealed weapons hidden all over her body. She also works as a waitress at the tavern "The Dim Shadow-Rat Inn." Nia has remarked that she wears surprisingly cute underwear.

name.native: ガンドルフ ・ローゲン

node.description: A muscular and earnest martial artist who passionately instructs students at the Artoire Academy dojo, serving as the acting assistant instructor for the Tenha-ryu school. He is admired by his students, and rumors suggest that, despite his youth, his skills surpass even those of the master instructor.

name.native: ヒュレンツ ・アルトワール

node.description: The 14th King of the Kingdom of Altoire. He is a capable monarch with the ambition and cold-bloodedness of a ruler, but he is aloof in his personal relationships, much to the exasperation of his daughter, Hildetora. He values Nia’s fearless courage as he works to popularize Magic Vision.

A formidable adventurer known by the epithet "Sword Demon." He is a swordsman from a foreign land, wielding a blade forged by a master craftsman. Driven by a desire to battle the strong and a singular obsession with the act of cutting down foes, he harbors a bottomless madness alongside his razor-sharp prowess.

name.native: ラフィネ・シルヴァー

node.description: The eldest daughter of the Silver family. She is a sophisticated woman dedicated to her career, having established a trading company in the fashion industry. With proven skills in makeup and styling, she provides reliable support—such as personally handling the makeup—during her younger sister Reliared's "Magic Vision" shoots.

name.native: リクルビタァ・シルヴァー

node.description:
The second daughter of the Silver family. Extremely shy and unable to hold a proper conversation with anyone outside her family, she prefers to stay in her room and draw.

She is a huge fan of [Nia](https://anilist.co/character/325674/Liston-Nia)—whom she discovered via Magic Vision—and harbors an extraordinary level of enthusiasm for her.

The third daughter of the Silver family and a third-year student in the junior high division of Altoire Academy. As a disciple of the Tenpa-ryuu school, she studies under Master Gandolf and trains diligently every day. She possesses enough skill to have finished as the runner-up in the junior high division's martial arts tournament.

name.native: エスエラ・ブランケット

node.description: A personal maid serving Reliared , the youngest daughter of the Silver family, and a practitioner of the Tenpa-ryuu style. She deeply reveres and adores her mistress, Reliared ; she also engages in a quiet rivalry with Rinokis—Nia’s maid—over whose mistress is the more adorable.
